newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK future leader Tung meets Singapore's Goh.
newsitem.headline: HK future leader Tung meets Singapore's Goh.

text.p: Singaporean Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong met Hong Kong's future leader Tung Chee-hwa on Sunday.
Goh was scheduled to meet Hong Kong governor Chris Patten on Monday as part of his visit to the British colony, which returns to China on July 1 after 156 years of rule from London.
Neither Tung nor Goh disclosed details to waiting reporters of what they discussed.
Goh completed a week-long official visit to China on Saturday.
